title: fix(ui): a destructive action block confirms through the destructive button
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8UvbzHXduHALDwfXpk6vCwo)_

Fixes #26665

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:四个动作块(`action:button` / `action:icon` / `action:group` / `action:menu`)把 `variant` 转发给动作执行器,`destructive` 在这一处转成 `danger`;`UIActionSchema.variant` 按引用取 spec 块行的词表(补上 `link`)。
- 为什么改:块里声明 `destructive` 的危险动作,确认框一直是中性按钮;执行器只认动作方言里的 `danger`,而四个块从不转发 `variant`。
- 风险与回滚:只影响带 `confirmText` 且 variant 为 `destructive` 的块,确认按钮改为红色;`default` / `outline` 不转发,行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/runner-variant.ts`(映射本身)、`action-button.tsx` 的 forward 一行、`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` 的 `variant`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-variant-confirm-26665.test.tsx`,预期 9 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`@objectstack/spec` spells `variant` in two dialects, each on its own surface (seat ruling: premise correction comment 6444873110 on #26665):

- the four action blocks' rows (`ActionButtonPropsSchema`, `ActionIconPropsSchema`, `ActionGroupPropsSchema`, `ActionMenuPropsSchema`, and the group/menu member items) take the Button primitive's vocabulary plus `primary`, and refuse `danger`;
- `ActionSchema`, which the runner dispatches, takes `primary | secondary | danger | ghost | link`. The runner reads `variant` for one purpose: `danger` paints the confirm button destructive (`confirmOptions` in `ActionRunner.ts`).

The four block renderers forwarded no `variant`, so a block declared `destructive` confirmed through a neutral button. Now:

- **`runner-variant.ts` (new, `@object-ui/components`)**: `toRunnerVariant` translates the block value into the action value at the one forward: `destructive` becomes `danger`; `primary`, `secondary`, `ghost` and `link` pass through; `default` and `outline`, which the action dialect has no word for, forward nothing. It reads no `danger`: it is not a reader-side alias.
- **The four renderers** forward `variant: toRunnerVariant(...)` beside `confirmText`. `action:group` and `action:menu` forward each member's own `variant`, not the container's.
- **`UIActionSchema.variant` (`@object-ui/types`)** is typed by reference to the spec's `ActionButtonProps['variant']`, the way `size` beside it already is. That adds `link`, which the block rows accept, and keeps refusing `danger`, which they refuse.
- **`ui/scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs`**: the four `SURFACE:variant` JUSTIFIED entries are removed; the gate now finds `variant` forwarded on all four surfaces.

## Why

The goal of the card is unchanged: a destructive action declared through one of the four blocks confirms through the destructive button. The method follows the seat's premise correction: the block rows keep their own spec dialect, and the translation lives at the forward, because each value is spec-declared on its own surface.

## Tests

- New `action-variant-confirm-26665.test.tsx`: per surface, a `destructive` action asks the confirm handler with `destructive: true`; the `outline` control asks without it; each row first asserts the handler was called once and that nothing ran after the cancel. One row pins the mapping table of `toRunnerVariant`.
- `action-forward-precedence.test.tsx`: `variant` added to the button and icon key-order lists, beside `confirmText` (one added name, no neighbour moved).

## Acceptance notes

- `action:group`'s inline members draw the group's `variant` when they declare none, but the forward carries only the member's own `variant`: the group's value is the container's style, not a declaration about each action.
- The `action:button` / `action:icon` registration `inputs` still publish the variant enum without `link`. Publishing it is a registry change with a manifest regeneration and is not in this card.
- `@object-ui/types` has no zod mirror of `UIActionSchema.variant`; the public-block zod faces take the spec rows by reference already.

## Verification

All local runs on head `631c2c46`.

<details><summary>Ablation (two mutations, both restored by blob hash)</summary>

- `runner-variant.ts`, `return 'danger';` replaced with `return undefined;` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed): 5 failed, the four `destructive` rows and the mapping row. Restored: blob equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `action-group.tsx`, the `variant: toRunnerVariant(action.variant),` forward deleted: 1 failed (the `action:group` destructive row), 8 passed. Restored the same way.

</details>

<details><summary>Reverse type check</summary>

A scratch file in `ui/packages/types/src` typed two `UIActionSchema` literals: `variant: 'link'` compiled, `variant: 'danger'` failed with TS2322 (the union printed is the block rows' seven values). The file was removed; the tree is clean.

</details>

<details><summary>Tests and type-check</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/renderers/action/` (under the verify lock, before the main merge): Test Files 35 passed (35), Tests 581 passed (581).
- The new pin alone: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 9 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` (under the lock): both packages Done, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:action-forward-parity`: exit 0, 26 justified omissions, 0 known gaps; `variant` forwarded on all four surfaces.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 34 families on head `631c2c46`; all 34 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` included, under the lock).
- `test:repo`, `pnpm lint` and the type-check lanes are CI's.

</details>
